[[File:Coruscant_docks.png|thumb|right|250px|The docks under the derrick major]]
{{Quote|Ono had a secret meeting at the docks under the derrick major the night before he died.|[[Mee Deechi/Legends|Mee Deechi]]|audio=OnoSecretMeeting-SM.flac|<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>}}
These '''Coruscant docks''' were located under the [[Derrick major/Legends|derrick major]] and was where cargo ships docked on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to load and unload [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]].

==History==
After [[Funeral of Onaconda Farr/Legends|his funeral]], [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] were directed to the docks while investigating who had killed [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]]. They were ambushed by an [[Lolo Purs/Legends|assailant]] who managed to escape, and later the docks became the scene of a criminal investigation by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Tan Divo/Legends|Tan Divo]] and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]].
